run_tokenize_indic_text: run the indic tokenizer script on text piped via stdin for a given language code
run_normalize_indic_text: run the indic normalizer on text input using IndicNormalizerFactory for a specified language
run_trivial_tokenize_indic: run trivial_tokenize on normalized Indic text for a given language code
review_indic_normalizer_factory: review the IndicNormalizerFactory usage for normalizing Indic script text with nuktas and nasals options
summarize_indic_tokenizer: summarize the indic tokenizer script that normalizes and tokenizes Indic language text from stdin
